ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Fischer Medical Ventures Limited reported mixed Q1 FY27 results, showing strong year-on-year consolidated revenue growth and a return to group-level profitability, despite a YOY consolidated profit decline and significant standalone losses. Material impacts include a substantial equity infusion from warrant conversions; however, simultaneous resignations of two Independent Directors and a restatement of prior period consolidated figures due to audit adjustments raise potential governance and financial reporting red flags.
